scope: C3b same-instance event-field provenance audit against the immutable RTL2 event vocabulary. This matrix is an audit artifact, not a scoreboard tap, trace, event source, or functional C4 closure.
global_rules: Only a named owner/carrier ready-valid fire with all immutable schema fields may become a later captured event.
An outer functional-memory response, a READY/state observation, or a test action is not an accepted architectural event.
No missing field may be inferred from private state, a constant, an unrelated publication member, or a later terminal.
Every row remains capture_authorized=false in P1; C4-P2 must bind each selected observation explicitly and separately.

rows.c3b_observation: The R2-to-R1 accepted request exists inside the composed typed path, but C3b exports only the functional external-memory port, not that owner-carrier fire.
rows.field_provenance: request_id/incarnation/reset_epoch/delivery_context_ref/candidate_class are not exposed together at a C3b harness output.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Do not use external.request fire; add no observation unless the exact R2-to-R1 accepted carrier and all fields are explicitly bound.

rows.c3b_observation: The typed delivery router is internal. The external-memory response is an environment input and is not the router acceptance.
rows.field_provenance: The required identity, context, fragment index, last, and status are not exported as one typed-router accepted carrier.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Reject environment response fire as a substitute; require an exact router-carrier observation.

rows.c3b_observation: R1 terminals reach R3/R5 through the internal typed path for payload, descriptor, and later reclaim maintenance.
rows.field_provenance: The schema fields are carried by the typed terminal association but no C3b output exposes that accepted owner-carrier.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: A future tap must distinguish the named R1 terminal operation and preserve all schema fields; external.response is insufficient.

rows.c3b_observation: R5's descriptor-durability prerequisite is the internal R5-to-R3 aggregate gate before publication.
rows.field_provenance: Its page, layer/head, group tag, required/durable masks are not exported at C3b; r5_visibility_ack_fire is later and lacks this record.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Do not recast visibility acknowledgement as descriptor durability; bind the prerequisite fire only if all fields are retained.

rows.c3b_observation: publication_commit is exported after publication acknowledgement, but it carries page/group/valid-record summary rather than a member entry_id, record_ordinal, and publication_status.
rows.field_provenance: The immutable event requires transaction_group_tag, entry_id, record_ordinal, page_ref, generation, publication_status; the latter three member/status fields are unavailable on this observation.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Fail closed: publication_commit may not emit metadata_publish_commit without a separately bound exact per-record accepted carrier.

rows.c3b_observation: automatic_publication_owner_mode routes R3 authority_transition_out into R6; io.r6_authority_transition_fire is that actual acceptance and io.r6_authority_transition preserves entry_id/from/to/tag.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: May be selected only by an explicit C0-consistent alias binding to the immutable R3-to-R6 schema carrier; no second authority owner or ordinal table.

rows.c3b_observation: C3 packet activation consumes S2's read-only s2_observe_available/identity/instance facts; they are not an accepted source-owner delivery handshake.
rows.field_provenance: source_valid is an owner state fact and no accepted carrier exposes the complete schema field set at the harness boundary.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Do not emit from READY/availability; identify a named accepted S2 source-owner carrier first.

rows.c3b_observation: c3Merge.consumer_partial_commit fires before the commit demultiplexer delivers the packed commit to S2.
rows.field_provenance: The internal commit carries transaction identity, source kind, source instance coordinate/generation, and consumer_id, but no outward C3b observation exposes its fire.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: A future observer must bind this exact merge-boundary fire, not the outer partial-provider packet or an S2 state transition.

rows.c3b_observation: s2_release_out is accepted by lifecycle.packed_source_release_in after S2's four consumer commits, but the fire is internal to the harness.
rows.field_provenance: Identity and source instance are present; all_four_consumers_committed may be asserted only by an explicit rule tied to this accepted release, never supplied as a default.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Expose/bind the accepted S2 release first and state the four-commit proof rule explicitly.

rows.c3b_observation: lifecycle.merge_req is accepted by c3Merge.merge_req_in; io.c3_merge_work is a later outer R4-reference work observation, not this R6 owner-carrier fire.
rows.field_provenance: The internal request carries transaction identity and source_presence, while the outer work boundary is not an interchangeable schema carrier.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Do not capture io.c3_merge_work; bind lifecycle-to-merge acceptance if this event is selected.

rows.c3b_observation: c3Merge's R4-origin terminal is accepted by lifecycle and exposed as io.c3_attention_terminal; the existing RTL2.4.3 binding already defines that same-handshake outward observation.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Reuse the existing binding only at io.c3_attention_terminal.fire; ready-low must emit nothing and preserve the held terminal.

rows.c3b_observation: R5 reclaim_candidate_out enters the existing R2/R1 maintenance path after R6 permit, but it is internal and identifies descriptor line/operation rather than an outward old page-ref release.
rows.field_provenance: The schema's old page_ref/generation and delivery_context_ref are not exposed together on an accepted C3b observation of the candidate.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Do not infer invalidation from a descriptor line or later reclaim_complete; use the existing R5 post-durable binding only if its precise carrier is observed.

rows.c3b_observation: R5 allocator_release_out is the post-durable old PageRef carrier and is consumed with ready=true inside the C3b harness.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: A test-only observer may bind allocator_release_out.fire without changing R5 ownership; reclaim_complete alone must not emit page_free.

rows.c3b_observation: After R5 reclaim_complete and final drain collection, lifecycle.session_retire_ack is exposed as io.c3b_retire_ack.
rows.c4_p2_requirement: Reuse the existing RTL2.5.5 binding only at io.c3b_retire_ack.fire; valid without ready emits nothing.

disposition.c4_p2_required: explicit accepted-carrier binding selection before any trace/witness change
